# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_15_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX>=15 filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will avoid low-volatility false signals that cause losses on non-J days, while preserving the edge on J days (which occurred during higher VIX regimes). This addresses the concentration issue seen in many strategies where profits come from a few high-volatility days.

## Mechanism

In addition to the existing context filters for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (time of day, SPY structure, EMA ribbon flip, confluence, no major news, daily loss budget, ribbon spread >=30c, no volume divergence, VIX confirmation), we add a hard filter: VIX (from SPX options chain) must be >= 15.0 at the time of entry. All other entry, stop, target, and position sizing rules remain unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L (based on 50% risk cap and typical entry premiums).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 used 16-month in-sample window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with all symbols in autoresearch queue. Selection method: automated grid search over VIX threshold values (10.0 to 25.0 in 0.5 increments). Overfit risk: mitigated by requiring walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window on top 3 J days pending; will report edge_capture and Sharpe upon completion)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills check on top 3 J days pending; will report % diff from BS sim upon completion)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: potential whipsaw in ranging markets with VIX>=15 but no follow-through (max single-day loss estimated -$500 based on historical volatility).
   - Max drawdown: strategy may still suffer during protracted low-volatility regimes if VIX filter fails to trigger (drawdown estimate -$2,000 based on historical equity curves).
   - Blow-up scenario: VIX spike >40 with sudden reversal causing multiple stopped-out trades (unlikely due to ribbon spread and volume divergence filters).
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X -- unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest and validation; target is to reduce concentration below 100% (current leaderboard shows many candidates >100%).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: 95/95 PASS (including new vix_filter_15_bearish_rejection_test.py)
- Walk-forward OOS: must show edge_capture >= 771 and Sharpe >= 1.0 on held-out window
- Real-fills: must show <15% difference from BS sim on top 3 J days
- Anchor no-regression: must not lose any of the 3 J winners (edge_capture delta >= 0 on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04)
- Concentration check: top-5 days <= 100% of P&L

## Confidence

6 / 10 -- Based on observation that J's winner days occurred during elevated VIX (4/29 VIX~22, 5/01 VIX~18, 5/04 VIX~25) and losing days often had lower VIX (5/05 VIX~14, 5/06 VIX~16, 5/07 VIX~12/13). However, VIX>=15 may still include choppy periods that generate false signals.
